_comment: M4 recorded-set labels — hand-labeled by eye (agent viewing each PNG), cross-checked vs the sidecar's recorded mover/world truth. presence: concept visible in frame. Convention: house present => building present (houses are buildings); gas_station => building only; car = car_1/car_2 (hatchback/SUV), truck = car_3 (delivery-truck model); pole = lamp_post (the gas-station totem is NOT labeled pole — noted where visible). exclude_from_recall: concept present only as a frame-edge sliver — kept OUT of the recall denominator (sliver detection is luck), still counts for FP denominators of other concepts.
